card_en: A feminine noun in -a ends in -o when it is the object, the thing you drink, have or get: kava je dobra, but pijem kavo. This is the accusative, as in imam sestro.

quick_check.explain_en: Kava is the thing you drink, the object, so -a becomes -o: pijem kavo.

helper_de: In German a feminine object looks like the subject: die Suppe ist gut, ich esse die Suppe. In Slovenian the ending changes: kava, pijem kavo.
helper_en: English shows the object only on pronouns, like he and him. Slovenian shows it on the noun itself: kava, kavo.
